title: Sequence Feasibility + Dead-End Detection + Auto-Resequencing + PUOA Integration
description: Build the SequenceFeasibilityEngine that forward-simulates the operation sequence, checking all physical feasibility constraints at each step. Detect dead-ends where completing one operation makes a future operation impossible. Implement backtracking search with constraint propagation to find valid orderings or prove none exist. Enhanced with PUOA integration for LLM-level AI reasoning.

units.title: SequenceFeasibilityEngine: forward simulation with accessibility, workholding, rigidity checks at each step
steps: simulate(): for each op in sequence: applyOperation → check ALL remaining ops for feasibility
Dead-end detection: if any remaining op fails accessibility, workholding, or rigidity → flag
Report format: 'After op N (rough pocket), op M (finish shelf) becomes impossible because tool cannot reach shelf through pocket walls'
Per-step checks: AccessibilityAnalysis + WorkholdingViability + RigidityDegradation for ALL remaining ops
Performance: cache IPW state at each step for backtracking without full recompute
riskScore(): Monte Carlo variation on uncertain parameters → P(success) per operation
findDeadEnds(): identify ALL dead-ends, not just the first one
exit_conditions: Forward simulation detects known dead-end scenario
20+ tests including dead-end, no-dead-end, and multi-dead-end scenarios

units.title: Auto-resequencing: backtracking search with constraint propagation to find valid orderings
steps: suggestReordering(): when dead-end found, search for valid orderings
Constraint propagation: prune impossible orderings early (e.g., roughing must precede finishing)
Heuristics: try 'outside-in', 'thick-to-thin', 'top-down' ordering strategies first
Backtracking with depth limit (max 1000 permutations for ≤15 ops)
If no valid ordering exists: report with explanation of conflicting constraints
Optimize valid orderings: among feasible sequences, pick best for cycle time/tool life
whatIf(): test impact of moving one specific operation
exit_conditions: Finds valid reordering for solvable dead-ends
Reports 'no solution' with explanation for unsolvable cases

units.title: SequenceFeasibilityEngine PUOA Integration: LLM/CLI sequence-based pre-flight
steps: assessSequenceForPUOA(): Returns PUOA-compatible assessment with risks, dead-ends, fallbacks
suggestResequencingForPUOA(): Returns resequencing suggestions in PUOA format
PUOASequenceAssessment: Output format matching PUOA pre-flight assessment
Risk categorization: accessibility, workholding, rigidity, datum_available, sequence
Dead-end reporting: blocking_op, blocked_op, reason
Severity levels: low, medium, high, critical
Fallback strategies: Recommended alternatives including resequencing
Success probability: Combined sequence-based probability (0-1)
PUOA assessSequenceFeasibility(): Direct entry point on PRISMUnifiedOrchestratorEngine
PUOA suggestResequencing(): Direct resequencing entry point
PUOA assessPreFlightWithSequence(): Enhanced pre-flight with sequence risk overlay
exit_conditions: Dead-ends converted to critical risks with resequencing fallback
PUOA engine has direct sequence assessment methods
Pre-flight enhanced with sequence risks prefixed [Sequence]

summary.ai_integration: Direct PUOA integration enables LLM-level AI reasoning with sequence-based pre-flight assessment including dead-end detection and auto-resequencing
